title: authority-limit-exceeded-during-iterative-action

proposition.statement: An iterative exchange must not permit a later offer or action to exceed the actor's mandate merely because earlier actions were in scope.

preconditions: The actor has a bounded mandate.
The interaction permits multiple proposals or revisions.
A later material action exceeds a value, counterparty, field or other mandate constraint.

trigger.statement: A later counteroffer or revised action is accepted without re-evaluating the material constraints.

evidence_required.statement: Current authority applicable at the material transition.
Constraint policy and evaluated results for the exact action.
Evidence linking the final action to the authority evaluation rather than an earlier interaction state.

falsification.condition: The final commitment is PASS even though a material constraint is exceeded.
Authority is checked only once at interaction initiation.
